rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors (Vision Pro, Leap Motion hand-tracking) and is explicitly building beyond simple wearables at Midjourney, while Saurabh is an AI engineer actively shipping AI-adjacent tools and has the backend/full-stack chops to prototype intelligent hardware interfaces. At a physical AI hackathon, Ahmad's conviction that next-gen AI hardware must be deeply integrated with generative models—not bolt-on—pairs well with Saurabh's hands-on builder mentality across Python, JavaScript, and agentic systems.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Saurabh Khire — Ahmad pioneered hand-tracking and spatial computing hardware at Apple and Leap Motion and is now leading Midjourney's AI-native hardware; Saurabh's an AI engineer and full-stack builder with experience shipping AI tools who could help prototype intelligent interfaces.
